introduce.metaTitle: Oyscat | GenPI’s First Realization · AI Electrified Making System
introduce.metaDescription: Oyscat by Shenzhen QiCore is the first realization of GenPI, an AI electrified making system. We rebuilt the full making workflow with AI design and simulation, standardized reusable electronic modules and agile assembly, so anyone can bring original ideas to life.
introduce.metaKeywords: Oyscat, GenPI, AI making, AI electrified making system, AI design and simulation, standardized electronic modules, reusable electronic modules, electrified making, QiCore, Shenzhen QiCore
introduce.ogImageAlt: Oyscat: the first realization of GenPI, making creation possible for everyone.
introduce.description: Make creation simpler. Turn hardware, crafts and everyday objects into creations of your own.
introduce.overviewTitle: Give every idea a place to begin.
introduce.libraryDescription: Organize your creations and save snapshots along the way, keeping a record of every experiment.
introduce.workspaceDescription: Bring parts, structures and code together in one workspace as your ideas take shape.
introduce.docsDescription: From getting started to module references, find what you need for your next creation.
introduce.betaBanner: Oyscat Workspace public beta coming soon

genpi.title: Rebuilding the making workflow, so creation feels like play
genpi.description: Oyscat is the first realization of GenPI. We reconnect every step from design and simulation to assembly, so anyone can bring an idea to life and make it their own.
genpi.pillar1Description: Generate models and control logic from natural language, then validate them in simulation before picking up a single part.
genpi.pillar2Title: Standardized, decentralized and reusable electronic modules
genpi.pillar2Description: Plug-and-play modules combine freely, programs can be rewritten, and every module can move straight into your next creation.
genpi.pillar3Title: Extremely agile electrified making for every creator
genpi.pillar3Description: An idea-to-object workflow connects 3D printing and handmade enclosures, keeping trial and error on screen and creation in your hands.
